pages.title: Item Frame Images
pages.text: You can display a custom image on any item frame — or even across an entire wall of frames! When multiple item frames are placed side-by-side all facing the same direction, DragIt automatically detects the whole group and spreads your image seamlessly across every frame like a mosaic.

pages.title: How to Use
pages.text: $(bold)1.$() Place item frames on a wall (or floor/ceiling). Make sure they are $(bold)touching each other and all facing the same direction$().$(br2)$(bold)2.$() Aim your crosshair at $(italic)any one$() of the frames.$(br2)$(bold)3.$() Drag an image file into the game window and let go.$(br2)$(note)You don't need to aim at a specific corner frame — DragIt figures out the full arrangement on its own.$()

pages.title: How the Grid Works
pages.text: DragIt automatically finds all item frames that are connected and facing the same way, figures out the grid, and cuts your image into the right pieces for each frame.$(br2)The end result is one seamless image spread across all the frames!

pages.title: Breaking a Frame
pages.text: $(warn)Breaking any single frame in a group removes the image from all frames in that group.$()$(br2)Make sure your frame arrangement is finalised before dropping an image. To update the image, simply drag a new one onto any frame in the group.

pages.title: Saving & Sharing
pages.text: Item frame images are saved to the world and shown automatically to players who join later.$(br2)Images are cached locally on each player's computer, so the full image only needs to be downloaded once.
